about.tagline: Pioneering B2B Industrial Packaging & Labeling Solutions
about.para1: Winner Pack Technologies Pvt. Ltd. supplies environment-friendly secondary and tertiary packaging materials. Guided by our motto "We Serve To Deserve", we supply premium quality solutions tailored to your operational needs.
about.para2: We specialize in engineered industrial packaging materials and end-to-end solutions, serving a diverse spectrum of manufacturing and supply chain sectors.

usps.title: Custom Specifications
usps.text: We manufacture to your exact width, gauge, and formulation requirements — ensuring the right fit for your production line.

usps.title: Consistent Roll Quality
usps.text: Our strapping rolls are manufactured to maintain uniform straightness and tension, enabling smooth operation on automated packaging lines.

usps.title: Superior Film Performance
usps.text: Our stretch films are formulated for maximum load-holding force and cling retention with optimized material usage per pallet.

usps.title: In-House Quality Testing
usps.text: Every batch undergoes rigorous elongation, tensile strength, and adhesive performance testing before dispatch.

usps.title: Eco-Friendly Options
usps.text: We offer recyclable and biodegradable packaging alternatives to support your sustainability and compliance goals.

usps.title: Direct Manufacturer Supply
usps.text: No distributor markups. We manufacture, warehouse, and dispatch directly to optimize operations and reduce procurement costs.

steps.title: Tell us your line.
steps.body: Share your SKU, payload profile and dispatch rhythm. Our team scopes the right strapping, shrink film or courier packaging for your operation.

steps.title: Material in your hands.
steps.body: We share a sample of the exact gauge, width and grade — PP/PET strap, shrink film or bubble roll — so you can test it before committing.

steps.title: Line qualification.
steps.body: For strapping, shrink wrapping and packaging workflows, our team helps test and tune material performance against your throughput.

steps.title: Confirmed pricing.
steps.body: We quote based on your volume and material spec, and confirm terms before production and delivery are scheduled.

steps.title: Scheduled delivery.
steps.body: Orders are dispatched from our manufacturing facility and delivered to your site as per the agreed timeframe.

steps.title: Ongoing service.
steps.body: We stay on for direct supply of strap rolls, films, packaging tools, and ongoing technical material optimization.

faqs.question: What is your typical quotation turnaround time?
faqs.answer: We share technical recommendations and initial pricing within one business day. For urgent operational shutdowns, call our direct line at +91 85950 72187 for priority assessment.

faqs.question: Do you supply production samples before commercial orders?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer sample rolls and trail quantities across films, strapping, and tapes so your quality team can test tensile load, elongation, and machine compatibility before volume sign-off.

faqs.question: Can products be manufactured to non-standard widths and thicknesses?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We supply tailored widths, custom micron gauges, core sizes, and roll lengths across all product lines to fit your exact manual or automated equipment.

faqs.question: Which geographic regions do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: We supply industrial accounts across Delhi-NCR, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, and pan-India through dedicated freight partners with scheduled dispatches.

faqs.question: What compliance certificates are provided with shipments?
faqs.answer: We supply Certificate of Analysis (COA), RoHS compliance, and batch-wise specification sheets upon request with commercial shipments.
